recommended_next_source: Restore the original locally generated data/benign_dynamic_urls.csv (or data/external/benign_dynamic/legitimate_dynamic_urls.csv) from the machine or job artifact that produced the benign URL reports. Do not substitute the 95-row subset or download data.
